landing.badge: AI interior designer, built for Türkiye
landing.heroText: Upload a photo and pick a style. Casalume refurnishes the room, repaints the walls and swaps the floor — then turns the design into a shopping list with a budget in Turkish lira.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything an interior designer does, in your pocket
landing.featuresText: We studied the best apps worldwide and added what people in Türkiye were missing.

features.title: Instant redesign
features.text: Transform any space, from living room to kitchen, with 15+ styles in seconds.

features.title: Turkish & Anatolian styles
features.text: Ottoman classic, Modern Turkish, Aegean, Cappadocia… local aesthetics, global quality.

features.title: Budget in TRY
features.text: Estimate furniture and renovation costs as Turkish lira ranges.

features.title: Shop Turkish stores
features.text: Search links for every piece on Trendyol, Hepsiburada and more.

features.title: AI design chat
features.text: Show your photo, ask, get ideas. Apply a suggestion in the studio with one tap.

features.title: Interior, exterior & garden
features.text: Furnish empty rooms, remove objects, paint, flooring, facade and landscaping tools.

features.title: KVKK-grade privacy
features.text: Location data is stripped from photos; images are served through expiring links.

features.title: Before / after compare
features.text: Drag to compare, switch between variants, download in high resolution.

Coming soon: project folders and client sharing
landing.stylesText: Tap a style to open the studio with it.
landing.pricingText: Start free; go PRO weekly, monthly or yearly when you need more.

faq.a: Uploaded photos are re-encoded and all EXIF data, including GPS location, is removed. Images are only reachable through expiring signed links, and deleting your account deletes all your designs.

faq.q: Can I use it without signing up?
faq.a: Yes. Start as a guest right away; create an account with your email later so you don't lose your designs.

faq.q: How accurate are the budget estimates?
faq.a: Prices are AI-estimated ranges for the Turkish market. Please check store prices before buying.

faq.q: Will my walls and windows change?
faq.a: No. Casalume keeps the room geometry, windows and camera angle and only changes decor, furniture and surfaces.
Cancel anytime from App Store / Google Play subscriptions on mobile, or from your account page on the web.

deletion.title: How to delete your account
deletion.intro: You can delete your Casalume account and all your data at any time.
deletion.inApp: In the app: Profile → Delete account.
deletion.onWeb: On the web: sign in, then My account → Delete account.
deletion.byMail: If you can't reach your account, write “Please delete my account” to {email} from your account's e-mail address; we delete it within 30 days.
deletion.what: Your account, designs, uploaded photos, credits, device registrations and consent history.
deletion.keep: Only records the law requires are kept for the required period (e.g. data-protection request records for 2 years after closing). Payment records are held by the App Store and Google Play.
deletion.subscription: If you have an active subscription, cancel it in the App Store or Google Play first; deleting the account doesn't stop it.
